A robot program failed to move "red_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".

obs = observe()
red_pen = obs["objects"]["red_pen"]
green_case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

# Find grasp candidates for red_pen
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")

# Choose candidate with fingers along the long axis (yaw ≈ object_long_axis_yaw)
candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if abs(c["yaw"] - red_pen["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1:  # Close to long axis
        candidate = c
        break

# Grasp the red_pen
grasp_result = grasp(candidate)

# Find free spots in green_case for red_pen
spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")["spots"]
if not spots:
    spot = {"x": green_case["center"][0], "y": green_case["center"][1], "object_long_axis_yaw": green_case["long_axis_yaw"], "clearance": 0.0}
else:
    spot = spots[0]

# Carry to spot above green_case with correct yaw
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])

# Lower until contact
lower_until_contact()

# Release the pen
open_gripper()

# Retreat
retreat()

# Check success
check("red_pen", "green_case")
